faq.title: Frequently asked questions
faq.q1: Do customers need to log in to answer a survey?
faq.a1: No. Customers just open the link or scan the QR code and answer right on their phone.
faq.q2: How does Vietnamese sentiment analysis work?
faq.a2: Text is normalized (diacritics, slang, emoji) and then passed through a Vietnamese language model to classify sentiment and topics. You can correct labels so the model learns.
faq.q3: Can my company's data mix with other companies' data?
faq.a3: No. Data is isolated per company at multiple layers, including the database layer.
faq.a4: Yes. Export multi-sheet Excel files and PDFs with charts for any time range.
